name: AMS Entertainment
notes: DJ (required from Wolf Lakes list). Andrew's lead.

name: Maty's Linens & Decor
notes: Drapery + lights + candles. Andrew's lead; confirm full inventory.

name: Frosted Cakery
notes: Top bakery pick: refined buttercream, ~376 Yelp reviews. Lock design in writing.

name: Hooper Photo & Film
notes: Top photo+video pick, one in-house team. ~$5.5k photo / ~$8.5k photo+video.

name: Franklin and Brianne
notes: Most romantic photography (Birdeye 5.0/48). Confirm video scope.

name: Ironfire Studio
notes: Cinematic films (video-only). Pair with a photographer if you want a dedicated film.

name: Dr. Loenheim ensemble (Fresno State)
notes: Andrew's off-list duet/quartet idea. Only the DJ is list-restricted, so this is allowed.

name: Kiku Floral
pros: Deepest track record — WeddingWire 4.9 (~99 reviews), multiple Couples' Choice. Candle/tea-light centerpieces fit the candlelit look. Family-owned ~40 yrs. Most accessible price (~$3k start).
cons: Confirm the portfolio reads romantic enough for your aesthetic.

name: Sweet Dreams Floral
notes: Wolf Lakes list. The drapery specialist.
pros: Only florist advertising pipe-and-drape (Yelp 4.8/~137). Strong if drapery is a hard requirement.
cons: Drapery may overlap with Maty's (rentals lead) — don't pay twice. Get a quote.

name: Sweet Memories Flowers
notes: Wolf Lakes list. Romantic/garden aesthetic; pricier (~$5k+).
pros: Closest to the romantic/garden look of the slate (Yelp 4.5/~18).
cons: Pricier (~$5k+). Confirm full drapery/candle/light installs, not just florals.

name: A Secret Garden
notes: Wolf Lakes list. Best-documented: WeddingWire 5.0/15, Birdeye 4.3/68, Yelp 64 reviews. Family-owned since 1998 (designer Aubrey). Price consultation-based (reportedly well below pricier competitors).
pros: Strongest reviews + reputation for nailing the couple's vision. Includes venue visits, samples, delivery, setup & teardown. No red flags. Contemporary-romantic, garden-leaning.
cons: Flowers + floral decor only — no drapery/candle installs found. Starting price not published.

name: Awesome Blossom
notes: Wolf Lakes list. Dana Horton, est. 2003, wedding-focused. Yelp ~12 reviews. Price not published.
pros: 20+ yrs wedding experience; praised for cost-cutting ideas and realizing visions. Simple-yet-elegant custom florals.
cons: Smaller footprint (few reviews). At least one detailed complaint re communication/responsiveness. Flowers only; no drapery.

name: Fresno Photo Booth Company
notes: TOP pick. Full Service $575/3hr (+$125/extra hr): unlimited 2x6 prints, attendant, full prop table, custom strip art, online gallery. Glam tier $799. Self-reported 905+ 5-star.
pros: Highest review volume + most complete standard package. Multiple booth types (open-air, enclosed, Glam, inflatable, VIP).
cons: Review platform unverified (self-reported). Confirm prints/hours in writing.

name: Smiley Photo Booths
notes: Value runner-up. Open-Air/Classic $495/3hr (attendant, custom prints, props, gallery). Glam $695, Mirror $849, 360 $999/2hr. Weddings since 2012.
pros: Best value for a standard 3-hr attended booth. Fun premium options (mirror, 360).
cons: Self-reported 5.0 (unverified). 360 tier is only 2 hrs at $999.

name: Wolf Lakes Park
notes: SIGNED 06/22/2026. Friday Ceremony & Reception, Lakeside English Garden, 5:30-11:30pm (6-hr limit). PLATED / hand-served dinner = 25% service fee: $103/pp x 1.25 = $128.75/pp; recorded at 125 guests = ~$16,094 (food+service). EXCLUDES alcohol (no-host bar $100 setup, or buy from venue, or corkage) and sales tax. Deposit: $1,000 paid at signing; +$2,000 non-refundable due ~90 days prior (~Jan 9 2027). Guarantee headcount due Fri 03/19/2027; balance due Wed 03/31/2027 (10 days prior). Min 75 guests (Fri). DJ MUST be from venue preferred list. Only white real petals; candles must be enclosed.
pros: Nearly all-inclusive per-person (catering + linens + china + chairs/covers + cake cutting + security + event manager + cider toast + lake cruises) - removes a separate caterer. Indoor backup pavilion (enclosable, heat/AC at no charge).
cons: Per-person scales with final headcount (min 75 Fri). Plated dinner adds 25% service fee (vs 18% buffet). Alcohol + sales tax additional. DJ restricted to venue list.
